title: Catstable HMP
description: Catstable is a server where you can experience the Unstable SMP. Also is soft hardcore.
body:
🐈 Catstable HMP

A soft-hardcore multiplayer survival server inspired by the Unstable SMP.

⚠️CATSTABLE HAS A FAKE TAB LIST, WE ARE NOT BOTTING.⚠️ [Turned off because people think we are botting]

Features

⏳ 30 Minutes Death Ban

If you die, you'll have to wait 30 minutes before you can join back.

⚔️ Griefing Allowed

Griefing and raiding are allowed, just be ready for people to do the same to you.

🚫 No Hacking or Cheating

Cheats, hacked clients, x-ray, etc. will get you permanently banned. If you think it was a mistake, you can appeal in our Discord.

🛠️ No Lag Machines or Game-Breaking Exploits
Don't intentionally lag the server or abuse bugs.

Other rules are in our Discord.

🧟 Mobcaps

Mob spawning is configured to simulate a high player-count world, similar to the Unstable SMP.

If we fully disabled mob spawning, stuff like trial spawners would not work.

👹 Monsters: 30

🐄 Creatures: 30

🐠 Water Creatures: 15

🦑 Water Ambient: 12

🦇 Ambient: 12

🌊 Underground Water Creatures: 14

🐟 Misc: 5


🌐 24/7 Server

The server is up all the time except for maintenances.

🖥️ Java Only

No Bedrock support.

🎙️ Proximity Voice Chat

Talk to players around you with Simple Voice Chat.

📢 Death Sound

When someone dies, the sound can be heard from around 100 blocks away.

💭 Proximity Chat

Chat normally with people around you.

⚠️CATSTABLE HAS A FAKE TAB LIST, WE ARE NOT BOTTING.⚠️ [Turned off because people think we are botting]

Credits

❤️ If you feel like you helped with the server in any way, feel free to message me on Discord and I'll make sure you're credited.
